FeastAshlands_Material.d: It's hard to tell whether the steam coming off of this dish is because it's freshly cooked or because of the asksvin meat in it. Either way, the spiced meat together with the vineberries and fiddlehead sprouts is so delicious that it doesn't matter!

FeastBlackforest_Material.d: You won't be able to resist this platter of delights from the Black Forest! Venison sirloin steaks are served together with spiced thistles and carrots, and the whole meal is tied together with delicious jams. Just have one more bite!

FeastDeepNorth_Material.d: Warming and filling, this meal will sustain you even during the coldest of days. Porridge and pancakes pair well with jams and sausages, making it hard not to come back for a second helping!

Feaster.d:
Set the table with whatever food and drink you fancy, and impress your guests with a delicious feast.

Once a feast has been eaten of, it won't return any resources if dismantled.

FeastMeadows_Material.d: A boar that has been roasted to perfection, glazed and served atop a bed of greens, with additional cuts of meat on the side. A feast like this is sure to fill your stomach and brighten your day!

FeastMistlands_Material.d: The time has come for mushroom enthusiasts to rejoice! Try different kinds of mushrooms, mushroom marinated seeker meat and mushroom-filled misthare, and don't miss out on the tasty sap dressing.

FeastMountains_Material.d: Gather around this steaming pot full of deliciousness and warm yourselves up again after a day out in the cold. The usually tough and chewey wolf meat has become tender enough to practically melt in your mouth, and the onions and carrots are made even tastier with exciting spices.

FeastOceans_Material.d: Fish, fish, and more fish! And also serpent meat, cut to look like fish! Explore the flavours of the Ocean, along with some grilled greens for those still practicing their sea legs.

FeastPlains_Material.d: There's nothing plain about this feast! Enjoy pies and loaves fresh from the oven, both sweet and savoury, and experience the culinary equivalent of a hug.

FeastSwamps_Material.d: Who knew that leeches were edible? With the correct preparation (lots of cooking and lots of seasoning) you will be able to serve them in this feast for the culinary brave. For those who have a sensitive stomach, there are also tasty skewers of sausages and turnips on the side.

BMR_CrimsonLegs.d: Crafted in the fiery heart of ancient forges, the Inferno Emberweave Pants blaze with power, their woven threads infused with the essence of smoldering embers. BMP_AdvanceMagicBook.d: Unlock the arcane potential of tomorrow with the Advance Magic Book. Its pages whisper secrets of spells yet to be mastered, empowering wizards to reach beyond their limits and rewrite the very fabric of reality.

BMP_BeginnersMagicBook.d: Unlock the mysteries of the arcane with the Beginner's Magic Book, your gateway to a world of enchantment and wonder. Whether you're conjuring your first spark or delving into the secrets of ancient incantations, let this tome be your guide on the path to becoming a true master of magic.

BMP_EitrBelt.d: Embroidered with arcane symbols and shimmering with latent magic, the Wizard's Belt whispers promises of power to those who dare to fasten it around their waist. BMP_CrystalTotem.d: Forged from the rarest crystals and ancient magic, the Crystal Totem hums with power, beckoning forth a mischievous ally from the depths. With a whisper and a shimmer, it conjures the elusive Slime, a playful yet potent companion ready to engulf foes in its jelly embrace.

BMP_EikthyrsStaff.d: Forged from the ancient roots of Yggdrasil, Eikthyrs Staff crackles with primal energy, whispering secrets of the natural world to its wielder. With each swing, it channels the might of thunderstorms and the tranquility of forests, a testament to the harmony between power and nature.

BMP_LightningStaff.d: Forged in the heart of a storm, the Lightning Staff crackles with untamed power, its tendrils of electricity dancing eagerly at the wielder's command. With each strike, it delivers a thunderous fury that leaves foes trembling in awe of its electrifying might.

BMP_MountainSoup.d: Crafted from the hearty bounty of high-altitude harvests, Mountain Soup is a warm embrace of nature's finest. Each spoonful tells a story of rugged peaks and crisp, clean air, delivering a taste of adventure with every savory sip.

BMP_MountainStew.d: Bold flavors mingle in a hearty embrace within Mountain Stew, a culinary expedition through rugged terrain. Savory meats, hearty vegetables, and aromatic herbs simmer together, offering warmth and sustenance reminiscent of a cozy cabin nestled in the heart of the wilderness.

BMP_MushroomJam.d: Indulge in the earthy symphony of flavors with our Mushroom Jam - a savory delight that marries the rich umami of handpicked mushrooms with a hint of sweetness. Spread it on toast, pair it with cheese, or elevate your favorite dishes with its uniquely bold taste.

BMP_MushroomPie.d: Indulge in a savory symphony of earthy delights with our Mushroom Pie. Delicately crafted with a medley of handpicked mushrooms, nestled within a flaky, golden crust. Each bite is a journey through woodland whispers and rustic charm, evoking warmth and comfort with every savory sensation.

BMP_SautedMeatMushroom.d: Indulge in the savory symphony of tender meat and earthy mushrooms, expertly sautéed to perfection. Each bite is a culinary journey through rich flavors and enticing aromas, making every meal a delightful experience.

BMP_MushroomPuff.d: A savory pastry filled with a rich and creamy mushroom mixture, seasoned with herbs and spices.

BMP_ArcticStaff.d: Forged in the heart of glacial caverns, the Arctic Staff channels the icy fury of the frozen north. With each strike, it unleashes a blizzard of frost, freezing foes in their tracks and leaving a trail of crystalline beauty in its wake.

BMP_HealStaff.d: Within the gentle curves of the Staff of Healing lies the promise of restoration, its ethereal energies whispering solace to the wounded and weary. Crafted with care and imbued with ancient magic, it stands as a beacon of hope amidst the chaos of battle, offering comfort and rejuvenation to those in need.

BMP_ModersInheritence.d: Inscribed with the wisdom of ages, the Moders Heritage whispers secrets of forgotten battles and ancient techniques. Each strike resonates with the legacy of its wielders, a testament to their valor and mastery. With every swing, it carves its own legend, etching its mark upon the annals of history.

BMP_NeckTotem.d: Forged in the fires of ancient magics, the Neck Totem pulsates with a sinister energy. When wielded, it beckons forth the legendary Neck from the depths of Valheim's dark forests. Beware its call, for once unleashed, the Neck's ferocity knows no bounds.

BMP_PoisonStaff.d: Forged in the darkest depths, the Poison Staff whispers ancient secrets as it weaves its deadly dance. Each emerald-tipped strike drips with venomous malice, corrupting foes with the shadows of decay.

BMP_SurtlingStaff.d: Forged in the fiery depths, the Surtling Staff channels the wrath of ancient flames. With each pulse, it conjures infernos to engulf adversaries, leaving naught but smoldering remnants in its wake.

BMP_FlameWand.d: Crafted in the fiery depths of an ancient forge, the Flame Wand ignites with the fury of a dragon's breath. Its enchanted core pulsates with untamed power, casting waves of searing flames that dance with every flick of the wrist. With each blaze it conjures, it leaves a trail of charred foes and scorched earth, a testament to its wielder's mastery over the flames.

BMP_IceWand.d: Forged in the heart of an eternal glacier, the Ice Wand whispers secrets of frost and chill. With every flick, it conjures a dance of icy tendrils, freezing the very air around it. In the hands of its wielder, winter's embrace becomes a formidable ally, turning foes to statues in a crystalline prison.

BMP_LightningWand.d: Forged in the heart of a storm, the Lightning Wand crackles with raw energy, a conduit between wielder and tempest. With each surge, it whispers tales of thunderous might, ready to unleash nature's fury upon those who dare challenge its wielder's command.

BMP_PoisonWand.d: In the hands of the cunning, it whispers promises of silent demise. With a flick, it releases a venomous haze, weaving through the air like a sinister dance. To foes, it's a harbinger of unseen peril; to wielders, a tool of clandestine mastery.

BMP_WolfTotem.d: Forged in the mystical fires of Valheim, the Wolf Totem is a weapon of ancient power. With each swing, it calls forth the enigmatic Occultist, a spectral guardian from realms beyond. Together, they prowl the battlefield, a formidable duo ready to unleash chaos upon any who dare to challenge them.

BMP_YagluthsInheritence.d: In the fiery depths of the forge, where legends are born and destinies forged, lies Yagluth's Heritage. Tempered in the flames of ancient wrath, it whispers tales of bygone battles and echoes the roar of a titan's fury. Wield it with reverence, for it carries the weight of a legacy, the power to shape history, and the fire to ignite the hearts of heroes.

BMP_SkullTotem.d: Unleash the ancient power of the Skull Totem, a weapon of bone and sorcery. With each strike, it calls forth a loyal skeletal guardian, bound to serve and fight at your side until the end. Let the echoes of the past fuel your conquests.

BMP_FlameScepter.d: Forged in the heart of blazing infernos, the Flame Scepter channels the fury of the sun itself. With each swing, it ignites the air, leaving behind trails of searing embers and scorching all who dare stand in its path.

BMP_IceScepter.d: Forged in the heart of the coldest blizzards, the Ice Scepter channels the frigid power of the northern winds. With each crystalline shard that dances from its tip, it whispers tales of frost and fury, freezing adversaries in their tracks and shattering the bravest of foes with the chill of absolute zero.

BMP_LightningScepter.d: Forged in the heart of a storm, the Lightning Scepter crackles with untamed power, a conduit between heaven and earth. With each strike, it echoes the fury of thunder, leaving nothing but awe and destruction in its wake.

BMP_FlameStaff.d: Forged in the heart of molten fires, the Flame Staff wields the fury of infernos. Its fiery tendrils dance with arcane energy, consuming foes in a blaze of searing destruction, leaving only ashes in its wake.

BMP_ThunderStaff.d: Crafted by the lightning-wielding masters of ancient lore, the Thunder Staff crackles with raw power, each strike echoing the fury of a storm unleashed. Its wielder becomes a conductor of nature's wrath, channeling thunderous energy to vanquish foes and command the very heavens.

BMP_DruidsTome.d: Within the ancient pages of the Druid's Tome lies the wisdom of the ages, whispered by the winds, sung by the rivers, and murmured by the trees. It is a companion to those attuned to the rhythms of nature, a guide through the verdant mysteries of the wild, and a key to unlocking the secrets of the earth itself.

BMP_Dvergr_Earring.d: Forged by the skilled hands of the Dvergr, these earrings whisper tales of ancient craftsmanship and resilience. Wear them, and feel the echoes of dwarven heritage resonate with each step, as sturdy as the mountains themselves.

BMP_FireResist_Earring.d: Forged in the heart of dragonfire, the Fire Resist Earring offers both protection and elegance. Crafted with ancient enchantments, it whispers promises of safety amidst searing infernos, a guardian against the flames' relentless wrath.

BMP_FrostResist_Earring.d: Crafted from enchanted ice crystals found only in the most frigid reaches of the realm, the Frost Resist Earring exudes an aura of glacial resilience. Adorned with intricate frost patterns, it whispers promises of protection against the biting chill, ensuring its wearer stands unyielding against the frozen onslaught of winter's wrath.

BMP_PoisonResist_Earring.d: Ward off nature's toxins with the Poison Resist Earring, a sleek and stylish accessory imbued with ancient enchantments. Crafted to repel venomous threats, this earring serves as a subtle guardian against the unseen dangers lurking in the shadows. Wear it with confidence, knowing that nature's deadliest poisons hold no power over you.

BMP_Eitr_Earring.d: Forged in the depths of primordial chaos, the Eitr Earring whispers ancient secrets to those who dare to wear it. Its shimmering tendrils hold the essence of creation and destruction, granting its bearer a glimpse into the mysteries of the cosmos.

BMP_BlazeArm.d: Forged in the heart of a dying star, this arcane firearm channels the primal fury of a thousand suns. Each shot ignites the very air, leaving a trail of blazing embers and searing heat in its wake. Wield it with respect, lest you be consumed by the inferno it commands.

BMP_FrostArm.d: Forged in the heart of an ancient glacier, the Frost Arm channels the icy wrath of the frozen north. Each shot fired encases its target in a crystalline tomb, leaving only silence in its wake.

BMP_VenomArm.d: Forged in the shadowy depths of an alchemist’s lair, this eldritch firearm pulsates with a sinister green glow. Every bullet it fires is imbued with a deadly poison, promising a slow and agonizing demise to its targets. Only those who embrace the darkness can wield the Venom Arm without succumbing to its toxic embrace.

BMP_AskvinTotem.d: Carved from ancient bone and imbued with primal magic, this totem pulses with the heartbeat of the wild. When invoked, it calls forth an asksvin, a mythical beast of immense strength and unwavering loyalty, to defend its master with ferocity unmatched.

BMP_CharredTotem.d: Forged in the heart of an ancient wildfire, this totem's scorched surface crackles with latent power. When invoked, it calls forth a charred skeleton, its bones smoldering with an eternal flame, to fight for its master. Beware, for the totem's wrath knows no bounds, and the dead do not rest easily.

BMP_DrakeTotem.d: Emblazoned with ancient runes and pulsing with arcane energy, the Drake Totem is a conduit to primal forces. With a whispered incantation, it beckons forth a fierce drake, loyal guardian and relentless warrior, to heed its master's call.

BMP_SeekerBruteTotem.d: Etched with ancient runes and pulsing with primal energy, the Seeker Totem beckons forth a fearsome guardian from the depths of the wilds. With a mere incantation, watch as the earth trembles and the air crackles with anticipation, summoning a towering Seeker Brute to heed your command and defend against any who dare challenge its master.

BMP_ValkyrieTotem.d: Forged in the fires of ancient battles, the Fallen Totem whispers tales of valor and sacrifice. With a single touch, it calls forth the spectral form of a fallen Valkyrie, her ethereal wings spanning the battlefield as she heeds the call of the worthy.

BMP_BeginnerStaff.d: A simple, lightweight staff crafted from polished wood, designed for novice spellcasters. It enhances basic magical abilities and provides modest protection, serving as a reliable tool for those new to the arcane arts.

BMP_BjornTotem.d: A carved relic of primal power, used to summon the mighty spirit beast Bjorn.

BMP_VileTotem.d: A twisted idol radiating dark power, used to summon the dread creature known as Vile.

NeckTailGrilled.d: This savoury, charcoal-grilled meat has a slight aroma of seaweed and grass.

FeastMeadows.d: A boar that has been roasted to perfection, glazed and served atop a bed of greens, with additional cuts of meat on the side. A feast like this is sure to fill your stomach and brighten your day!

PulledBear.d: Tender meat cooked for hours upon hours, until it practically falls apart.

QueensJam.d: That classic tasty blend of raspberries and blueberries.

CarrotSoup.d: A warm tasty soup made of mostly carrots.

MinceMeatSauce.d: Chunks of goodness in a thick gravy.

FeastBlackforest.d: You won't be able to resist this platter of delights from the Black Forest! Venison sirloin steaks are served together with spiced thistles and carrots, and the whole meal is tied together with delicious jams. Just have one more bite!

FishCooked.d: A tasty side of smoked fish.

BlackSoup.d: A perfect balance of sweetness and acidity.

SerpentMeatCooked.d: A cooked slice of sea serpent. Smells good.

FeastSwamps.d: Who knew that leeches were edible? With the correct preparation (lots of cooking and lots of seasoning) you will be able to serve them in this feast for the culinary brave. For those who have a sensitive stomach, there are also tasty skewers of sausages and turnips on the side.

FeastOceans.d: Fish, fish, and more fish! And also serpent meat, cut to look like fish! Explore the flavours of the Ocean, along with some grilled greens for those still practicing their sea legs.

FeastMountains.d: Gather around this steaming pot full of deliciousness and warm yourselves up again after a day out in the cold. The usually tough and chewey wolf meat has become tender enough to practically melt in your mouth, and the onions and carrots are made even tastier with exciting spices.

CookedLoxMeat.d: A great hunk of tender meat, food fit for Valhalla!

FishWraps.d: Bread and fish, what more to wish?

LoxPie.d: Break the crust to release a cloud of fragrant steam. Delicious!

VikingCupcake.d: A sweet and tasty treat, to celebrate a feat!

FeastPlains.d: There's nothing plain about this feast! Enjoy pies and loaves fresh from the oven, both sweet and savoury, and experience the culinary equivalent of a hug.

RoyalJelly.d: Jelly fit for kings and queens.

MushroomMagecap.d: A mushroom commonly used in a sorcerer's diet.

MushroomJotunPuffs.d: An invigorating mushroom that can be used for cooking.

CookedBugMeat.d: Succulent white meat. A true delicacy.

MushroomOmelette.d: A delicious omelette with an earthy aftertaste.

YggdrasilPorridge.d: Made with sap from the great tree. Even a mouthful imparts a warm glow to your whole body.

SeekerAspic.d: A quivering jelly with a taste like gentle electricity.

FishAndBread.d: Bounty from both land and sea.

HoneyGlazedChicken.d: Grilled to perfection. Makes both eyes and mouths water.

FeastMistlands.d: The time has come for mushroom enthusiasts to rejoice! Try different kinds of mushrooms, mushroom marinated seeker meat and mushroom-filled misthare, and don't miss out on the tasty sap dressing.

MushroomSmokePuff.d: Hopefully it tastes better after cooking.

Vineberry.d: These juicy berries are both sour and sweet.

CookedAsksvinMeat.d: This meat has a potent and mature flavour, but is very tasty when grilled right.

CookedVoltureMeat.d: A chewy and somewhat dry meat. Some seasoning would probably make it taste better, but it'll fill your stomach regardless.

CookedBoneMawSerpentMeat.d: The boiling sea did nothing to this meat, but grilling it over the fire has given it a delightful crisp.

FierySvinstew.d: This musty stew is a necessity on every adventurer's menu.

SpicyMarmalade.d: Sugary honey perfectly balanced with tangy fronds and tart berries.

ScorchingMedley.d: A varied diet is important, so why not try this vegetarian option?

MashedMeat.d: Leftover meat can actually be pretty tasty if you just mash it right!

SizzlingBerryBroth.d: This soup settles in your stomach with an almost tingly sensation.

SparklingShroomshake.d: Perhaps it's not the best flavour to start the day with, but it will give you the boost you need.

PiquantPie.d: It takes some time and effort to make this pie, but the taste is well worth it.

RoastedCrustPie.d: This dessert keeps you going all day long.

MarinatedGreens.d: It's spicy, it's chewy, it's sweet… This mad dish tickles your tongue as well as your mind.

FeastAshlands.d: It's hard to tell whether the steam coming off of this dish is because it's freshly cooked or because of the asksvin meat in it. Either way, the spiced meat together with the vineberries and fiddlehead sprouts is so delicious that it doesn't matter!

Oat.d: Tasty grains, to be used as they are or to be ground into flour.

Poteitr.d: The possibilities are practically endless. Who wouldn't want a taste?

CookedSealBlubber.d: A chewy meat, with an aftertaste of remorse.

CookedMooseMeat.d: This meat is lean yet full of flavour.

BakedPoteitr.d: Neither boiled nor mashed nor in a stew. Still delicious though!

SmokedMooseMeat.d: The smoke only adds to the wild flavour.

SmokedFish.d: Fish prepared in the most delicious way.

MeatballsMashedPoteitr.d: It doesn't get more iconic than this!

MooseKebab.d: A convenient meal, often favoured by travelling merchants.

SealSoup.d: A warm and tasty meal, best enjoyed on a cold day.

OatmealLingonberryJam.d: Served with a generous helping of lingonberry jam.

Pancakes.d: Was there ever a more comforting food?

FeastDeepNorth.d: Warming and filling, this meal will sustain you even during the coldest of days. Porridge and pancakes pair well with jams and sausages, making it hard not to come back for a second helping!

Pukeberries.d: Allows the consumer to quickly evacuate any misplaced meal and start anew.

MushroomBzerker.d: Some say you can eat everything you find in the forest. That is not the case with this mushroom.

RottenMeat.d: There are maggots crawling in the meat. It smells awful.

MeadTasty.d: The nectar of the Gods, divine mead.

MeadBzerker.d: Something poisonous stirs within, brewed to the point where its potential can finally be harnessed. But be careful to let the beast out...

MeadHasty.d: The squirrel must be quick on its feet as it runs up and down the trunk of the world tree. Although it no longer visits Valheim, there are still those who remember it...

MeadSwimmer.d: You feel invigorated just by holding this, as the ocean beckons you to come for a swim.

MeadLightfoot.d: This bottle is full, yet it feels like it weighs almost nothing at all.

MeadStrength.d: What creature can carry more than a troll? Why, a viking with this drink of course!

MeadTamer.d: It smells like a pigsty. Likely the taste won't be much better.

MeadBugRepellent.d: The perfect drink for a day in the Plains.

MeadTrollPheromones.d: An intense musk permeates the air around this bottle.

BMP_MountainSoup.d: Crafted from the hearty bounty of high-altitude harvests, Mountain Soup is a warm embrace of nature's finest. Each spoonful tells a story of rugged peaks and crisp, clean air, delivering a taste of adventure with every savory sip.

BMP_MountainStew.d: Bold flavors mingle in a hearty embrace within Mountain Stew, a culinary expedition through rugged terrain. Savory meats, hearty vegetables, and aromatic herbs simmer together, offering warmth and sustenance reminiscent of a cozy cabin nestled in the heart of the wilderness.

BMP_MushroomJam.d: Indulge in the earthy symphony of flavors with our Mushroom Jam - a savory delight that marries the rich umami of handpicked mushrooms with a hint of sweetness. Spread it on toast, pair it with cheese, or elevate your favorite dishes with its uniquely bold taste.

BMP_MushroomPie.d: Indulge in a savory symphony of earthy delights with our Mushroom Pie. Delicately crafted with a medley of handpicked mushrooms, nestled within a flaky, golden crust. Each bite is a journey through woodland whispers and rustic charm, evoking warmth and comfort with every savory sensation.

BMP_MushroomPuff.d: A savory pastry filled with a rich and creamy mushroom mixture, seasoned with herbs and spices.

BMP_SautedMeatMushroom.d: Indulge in the savory symphony of tender meat and earthy mushrooms, expertly sautéed to perfection. Each bite is a culinary journey through rich flavors and enticing aromas, making every meal a delightful experience.

+15% sword attack speed. Parrying grants an additional +10% sword damage for 5s.
+7% bow and crossbow damage.
25% chance to not consume arrows or bolts.

+15% bow and crossbow damage. Hits beyond 25m gain an additional +10% damage.
+8% blunt damage with clubs, maces, and two-handed hammers.
Blunt weapons weigh 50% less and impose no movement speed penalties.
One-handed mace heavy attacks create a 3m shockwave for 25% weapon damage. Two-handed hammer attacks create a 3m aftershock on direct enemy hits for 20% weapon damage.

+15% blunt damage. Staggering an enemy grants +10% attack speed with blunt weapons for 5s.
+7% knife damage.
Knife attacks and stealth movement consume 15% less stamina. Additionally, you move at normal movement speed while crouched.
First knife hit from stealth deals +50% damage. After a stealth hit, knife attack speed is increased by 20% for 5s.
Knife hits apply stacking poison damage over time, up to 3 stacks. Poison damage scales with knife skill.
+15% knife damage against poisoned targets. Poisoned enemies deal 10% less damage to you.
+8% unarmed damage.
Unarmed attacks consume 10% less stamina and jumping while unarmed consumes 10% less stamina.
Every 3rd consecutive unarmed hit deals +50% damage and restores 5% stamina. Combo resets after 4s without an unarmed hit.
Unarmed attacks deal bonus spirit damage equal to 10% of weapon damage equivalent.
After taking damage, enter Rage for 5s: +10% unarmed damage and +20% attack speed. 20s cooldown.
+7% elemental magic damage.
Eitr granted by food is increased by 15%.
Dealing elemental magic damage grants +25% Eitr regeneration for 6s. Additional elemental magic damage refreshes the duration.
Elemental magic weapon Eitr costs are reduced by 10%.
Dealing 500 damage of a single elemental affinity triggers its matching Archmage aura for 20s. Only one Archmage aura may be active at a time.
+8% pierce damage with spears and polearms.
Thrown spears automatically return to the player after reaching their target, and polearms impose no movement penalties.
Spear hits build up to 5 stacks; each stack grants +3% attack speed for 5s. Polearm hits build up to 5 stacks; each stack grants +3% stagger damage for 5s.
Spear and polearm attacks deal bonus lightning damage equal to 12% of weapon damage.
+15% spear and polearm damage. Thrown spear hits beyond 15m and polearm special attacks gain an additional +10% damage.
+8% block power and -8% block stamina cost.
Shields impose no movement speed penalties.
Blocking within the first moment of an incoming hit restores 8 stamina and empowers your next attack or shield bash within 4s for +20% stagger.
Blocked attacks return pierce damage equal to 20% of the original blocked damage.
After blocking 200 damage, release a 5m shockwave dealing 200 blunt damage and high stagger. 10s cooldown.
+8% axe damage with one-handed axes and battleaxes.
Axes weigh 50% less and impose no movement speed penalties.
One-handed axe hits against the same target build up to 3 stacks; each stack grants +5% damage to that target for 5s. Battleaxe special attacks apply all 3 stacks at once.
Axe attacks apply bleed, dealing slash damage over time equal to 12% of weapon damage over 5s. Reapplying bleed refreshes the duration.
+15% axe damage. Axe attacks deal an additional +10% damage against enemies below 40% health.
+7% blood magic damage and summoned creature damage.
Health granted by food and food-based health regeneration are increased by 15%.
Sacrificing health with a blood magic weapon grants Blood Pact for 8s, increasing blood magic and summoned creature damage by 20%. Additional qualifying sacrifices refresh the duration.
Blood magic weapon Eitr costs are reduced by 10%. Health sacrifice costs are unchanged.

Health-sacrificing blood magic casts build Bloodwell charges. At 4 charges, gain Sanguine Reclamation for 20s: blood magic and summoned creature damage restores 5% of damage dealt as health, capped at 5 health per second.
